description: Secondary use: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic, scattered throughout the remainder of the fragment. Late. The calligraphic practice on the verso includes the signatures of multiple members of the same family: Yiṣḥaq al-Gavālī (=Jabālī?), Saʿdiya al-Gavālī, and ___[?] al-Gavālī. The first letter in the identified signature may be ר כ ד or perhaps מ. Requires further examination.
description_he: חשבונות בערבית-יהודית, מפוזרים לאורך שאר הקטע.
